# Life Audit

## Purpose
Assess the state of the Life department in the whole system: how well health, mind, relationships, learning, money, and home hold together, and where they are weak.

## Scope
- Health and body
- Mind and focus
- Relationships and family
- Learning and growth
- Personal money and reserves
- Home and daily environment

## What is in place
- [ ] Health basics tracked: sleep, movement, and recovery
- [ ] Time for deep work protected from grind
- [ ] Relationships with regular, real contact
- [ ] Learning with a visible next step
- [ ] Emergency fund and cold money tracked against their targets
- [ ] Home and daily routines that hold without effort

## Gaps
- [ ] Sleep or recovery collapsing under work
- [ ] No protected time for the main work
- [ ] Relationships going quiet for weeks
- [ ] Learning with no next step
- [ ] Emergency fund below target with no plan to close it
- [ ] Daily life running on willpower instead of routine

## Next steps
- Pick the highest priority gap and name its owner
- Add or fix the missing agent, skill, command, or workflow for that gap
- Run the new piece on a real week of life and check the result against evidence
- Record the decision and the outcome in the decision log
- Repeat for the next gap
- Share the finished audit and the changes with the people who need them, so the work reaches distribution
